title: Krooked Kreek Golf Course

blurb: Located just two miles east of Osceola, Wisconsin on County Road M and just 45 minutes from the Twin Cities, KKGC first opened for play in 1990 with only the front nine holes available. The back nine holes were added in 1995 to complete our challenging 18-hole facility.
